items.title: Luther Henderson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Maiden name was Black. Florence Black Henderson.

ctx.x: Couple of questions: What are the names of your mother and father?

My mother's name was Florence Henderson. Maiden name was Black. Florence Black Henderson. She was born in College Springs, Iowa. She was part of, um, the one black family that existed in that small college town. And my father's name was Luther, Luther Henderson, Luther Lincoln Henderson. And as I told you I was a Jr. and when he passed, I dropped the Jr and so forth.
